telegram.title: Connect a Telegram account
telegram.description: Sign in to Telegram with a QR code and MetaMCP creates the MCP server for you — no session string to generate by hand.
telegram.credentialsHelp: Create an application to get these at
telegram.envHint: An admin can set TELEGRAM_API_ID and TELEGRAM_API_HASH on the MetaMCP backend to skip these fields for everyone.
telegram.usingServerCredentials: Using the Telegram API credentials configured on this server.
telegram.usingServerCredentialsWithId: Using the Telegram API credentials configured on this server (app ID {{apiId}}).
telegram.serverCredentialsProblem: The server's Telegram API credentials are not usable: {{problem}}
telegram.commandHelp: Command that starts the Telegram MCP server. MetaMCP passes TELEGRAM_API_ID, TELEGRAM_API_HASH and TELEGRAM_SESSION_STRING to it.
telegram.qrRefreshes: The code refreshes automatically until you scan it.
telegram.stepDevices: Go to Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device.
telegram.stepScan: Point your phone at this code.
telegram.passwordNeeded: This account has two-step verification enabled. Enter your Telegram cloud password to finish signing in.
telegram.createHelp: MetaMCP will create the MCP server "{{name}}" for this account. The session string is stored in the server's environment variables and is never sent to the browser.
telegram.invalidName: Server name must only contain letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
telegram.invalidApiId: API ID must be a positive integer
telegram.invalidApiHash: API hash must be 32 hexadecimal characters

instagram.title: Connect an Instagram account
instagram.description: Sign in and MetaMCP creates the MCP server for you — no cookies to dig out of devtools by hand.
instagram.passwordHelp: Used once to sign in and is never stored. MetaMCP keeps only the session cookies Instagram hands back.
instagram.codeFromApp: This account has two-factor authentication on. Enter the code from your authenticator app.
instagram.codeFromSms: This account has two-factor authentication on. Enter the code Instagram just sent you.
instagram.codeFromSmsWithHint: This account has two-factor authentication on. Enter the code Instagram sent to the number ending in {{hint}}.
instagram.createHelp: MetaMCP will create the MCP server "{{name}}" for this account. The session cookies are stored in the server's environment variables and are never sent to the browser.
instagram.invalidName: Server name must only contain letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens
instagram.commandHelp: Command that starts the Instagram MCP server. MetaMCP passes INSTAGRAM_SESSION_ID, INSTAGRAM_CSRF_TOKEN and INSTAGRAM_DS_USER_ID to it.
instagram.useCookiesInstead: Instagram blocking the sign-in? Paste cookies from your browser instead
instagram.backToSignIn: Back to signing in with a password
